title: 第499章 龙骨第498章 七重
slug: 苟在武道世界加点长生
content_zh:
纳铁没想到这越南政府手段这么强硬，这样强行干扰人家酒店的营业，而这家酒店的老板似乎也没说什么了，这也是出乎了纳铁的意料之外。
他的课竟然有人敢迟到？或者说正常的训练，竟然敢有人迟到？从来没有发生过，这是开天辟地第一次。
紫月嘴角扬起一抹浅笑，深邃的眸扫了一眼在场的众人，最后落到火熙的身上，点了点头。
“没什么事，你们先聊着。”
唐唐还惦记着唐门秘笈，还一心想着白少紫体内的红尘度，虽然她喜欢欣赏帅哥，就如喜欢看到白卓紫一样。
两人的心底都有些沉重，微微叹息，却是知道，根本追不上去了。
“哎呀，都旧了，怎么能穿去长公主府呢？”
梨花左看右看没一件满意的。
时间一点一点的过去了，但是贱人下和猪头虎却发现，这条白玉阶梯仿佛像是没有尽头一般，仙宫眼前尽在咫尺，但是却怎么走也走不到。
“那这胭脂醉能解吗？”
沈薇问出了大家都关心的问题，管它出现得蹊跷不蹊跷，先解毒才是正事。
一片两片三片，好像是承受不住空中压抑的空气一般，树叶翩然而落，不带着一丝一毫的波动，就像是从树上自然落地的树叶一般，绵软无力。
“好吧，既然你这么执着，那我去给你拿床被子过来，也不知道你在别扭什么。”
林墨寒假装转身。
郁风闻言忽然点了点头，“没问题，这事包在我身上了，你去帮我把衣服补了就行了。”
说着便起身从屋子墙角之下拿起了一个铲子，老老实实去收拾粪便去了。
可怜的童乖乖还不知道腹黑大爷以她生气为乐，在一旁饶有兴致的观察着。
童乖乖在极度的尴尬中松开了手，其实云泽也没说什么，云泽一直端端正正的坐着，也没朝童乖乖发火。
这一瞬间犹如晴天霹雳，蔡冰儿感觉身边有一股不安详的气息环绕在她身边，于是她慢慢的睁开了眼睛，他们两人四目向对。
二人一同向着阵法所在之处走去，一路上卞禄还在苦口婆心地向魔心讲解着注意事项，而魔心的心思却没有在这里，他此刻一句话也听不进去了，可怜那卞禄一路上费了半天的口舌。

萧逸辰和莫浅夏对于外界的事物本没有感觉，突然他们感觉到一股不一样的气氛环绕在他们身边，心里有些奇怪，莫浅夏和萧逸辰两人纷纷抬起头。
顾先生，这里可是公共场所，你知道你自己再说什么吗？这是不行的！
沈心怡一脸严肃的看着他，尤其是这些都新闻，要是被拍到了，播出去了，她的脸通红。
“你是什么人，为何混入鲁神修行人员之中。
来此行凶作恶有什么目的。”
杜越松用力向前一推，将田疑逼退了几步。
北京的秋天一向很短，一次寒流袭卷，气温就降低的有些不人道，可是北京供暖的时间还没到，晚上有些冷，顾阑珊还特地去超市里买了一条新被子。
这个貌似，不关她的事吧，如果要是天然形成，偏偏就在今天塌了，那她又得被人说了。
记得你以前问过我最想要的是什么，现在我可以回答你：是真实，自由，还有爱情。
content_en:
Na Tie didn't expect that the Vietnamese government would be so tough and interfere with the business of other hotels. The owner of the hotel didn't seem to say anything. This was also beyond Na Tie's expectation.
Someone dared to be late for his class? Or how dare someone be late for normal training? This has never happened before, this is the first time in history.
Ziyue raised a slight smile at the corner of her mouth, her deep eyes glanced at everyone present, and finally landed on Huo Xi, and nodded.
"It's nothing, just chat first."
Tangtang was still thinking about the secrets of the Tang Sect, and she was still thinking about the worldliness in Bai Shaozi's body, although she liked admiring handsome men as much as she liked seeing Bai Zhuozi.
Both of them felt a little heavy in their hearts and sighed slightly, but they knew that there was no way they could catch up.
"Oh, it's already old, how can I wear it to the eldest princess's mansion?"
Lihua looked around and found nothing she was satisfied with.
Time passed little by little, but Bitch and Zhu Touhu discovered that this white jade staircase seemed to have no end. The Immortal Palace was within easy reach, but they could not reach it no matter how far they walked.
"Can this rouge drunkenness be cured?"
Shen Wei asked a question that everyone was concerned about. Regardless of whether it appeared strange or not, detoxification first was the business.
There were two leaves and three leaves, as if they couldn't bear the oppressive air in the sky. The leaves fell gracefully without any fluctuation, just like the leaves falling naturally from the tree, soft and weak.
"Okay, since you are so persistent, then I will go get you a quilt. I don't know what you are so embarrassed about."
Lin Mohan pretended to turn around.
Yu Feng suddenly nodded when he heard this, "No problem, I'll take care of this. Just go and mend my clothes."
After saying that, he stood up, picked up a shovel from under the corner of the room, and went to clean up the feces.
Poor Tong Guaiguai didn't know that the sinister old man took pleasure in her being angry and was watching with interest.
Tong Guaiguai let go of his hand in extreme embarrassment. In fact, Yunze didn't say anything. Yunze kept sitting upright and didn't get angry at Tong Guaiguai.
This moment was like a bolt from the blue. Cai Bing'er felt an uneasy aura surrounding her, so she slowly opened her eyes, and the two of them looked at each other.
The two of them walked towards the formation together. Along the way, Bian Lu was still explaining the precautions to Mo Xin earnestly, but Mo Xin's mind was not here. He couldn't listen to a word at the moment. It was pitiful that Bian Lu spent a long time talking along the way.
Xiao Yichen and Mo Qianxia had no sense of things in the outside world. Suddenly they felt a different atmosphere surrounding them. They felt a little strange in their hearts. Mo Qianxia and Xiao Yichen raised their heads one after another.
Mr. Gu, this is a public place. Do you know what you are going to say? This won't work!
Shen Xinyi looked at him seriously, especially since these were all news. If they were photographed and broadcast, her face would turn red.
"Who are you and why did you get mixed up among Lu Shen's cultivators.
What is the purpose of coming here to do evil? "
Du Yuesong pushed forward hard, forcing Tian Xin to take a few steps back.
Autumn in Beijing is always short. When a cold wave hits, the temperature drops to an inhumane level. However, Beijing's heating time has not yet come, and it is a bit cold at night. Gu Lanshan went to the supermarket to buy a new quilt.
This seems to have nothing to do with her. If it was naturally formed and collapsed today, then she would have to be blamed again.
I remember you asked me before what I want most, and now I can answer you: truth, freedom, and love.
